accepted_plan.summary: Implement explicit `yoi resume [--all]` CLI, remove top-level bare Pod-name inference, make default resume workspace-scoped by Pod metadata, preserve explicit `--pod <NAME>`, update help and focused parser/TUI tests.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates child worktree and records acceptance. Coder gets narrow write scope for implementation worktree. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s), then Orchestrator integrates approved branch into `orchestration`, validates, records closure, and cleans only child worktree/branch.
